build_dataset_mnist: build a TensorFlow dataset builder for MNIST handwritten digit images with 60k train and 10k test splits
create_dataset_fashion_mnist: create a TensorFlow dataset builder for Fashion-MNIST with 10 clothing category labels
build_dataset_kmnist: build a TensorFlow dataset builder for Kuzushiji-MNIST Japanese character images
create_dataset_emnist: create a TensorFlow dataset builder for EMNIST with configurable splits like balanced, letters, digits, and byclass
extract_mnist_images: extract MNIST image data from a binary idx3-ubyte file into a numpy array of shape (N, 28, 28, 1)
